versions.localizedDescription:
English:

This release fixes the v1.0 shell, which could not be packaged by anyone. If you downloaded D2RMobile-shell.ipa from v1.0, replace it with the one on this page and update the repository to this version.

What changed:

• The shell is now built from the public tree in a fresh working directory; it no longer asks for the prefetch list.
• When the public tree has no prefetch list, the rewrite step now also removes any old copy left in the build output directory.
• If the tool still finds an item it could not produce, the error now says the shell and the tool are from different versions and what to do.

Assets:

• D2RMobile-shell.ipa: the shell (for both iPhone and iPad). Its checksum is in SHA256SUMS.txt. Use it with the source of this version.

Not verified (stated plainly):

• This shell file has not been run on a device. The package made from it was written successfully on a Mac; it has not been signed and installed on a phone.
• Everything listed as not verified in v1.0 still applies: sideloading tools (Sideloadly, AltStore, .), devices with 6 GB or 8 GB of RAM, A16 or older chips, .nsp game packages, packaging on Linux.
